**MKIT (HONG KONG) HOLDINGS LIMITED**, founded as an internet company in Hong Kong in 2016, has branches in Beijing, Hong Kong, Singapore, India, and other places. With an international outlook, we are dedicated to providing growth services for Chinese overseas enterprises.

* **Visit our website:** www.giantsage.com

We help clients from various industries recruit for various positions such as BD, Sales, Marketing, and Operations overseas. Our current positions span across the globe, including Asia Pacific (Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam), Europe (UK, Germany, France, Russia), the Middle East (Saudi Arabia, UAE), and Latin America (Mexico, US, and Australia).

* Coordinate and resolve various problems occurring throughout the recruitment process to ensure smooth project delivery.

* Clear, logical communication, excellent stress resistance, and outstanding capabilities in team empowerment and result delivery.

* Do you have 3 or more years of professional experience in the recruitment/headhunting industry? (Yes or No)

* Are you fully available to work with us from 9:30 - 12:00 and 13:30 - 18:00 (China Standard Time - CST)? (Yes or No)

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Department:** Human Resources – Talent Acquisition  
**Job Location:** Rohini West, New Delhi  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Work From Office  
**Interested candidates can call me or whataspp me on 92890 08078**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Talent Acquisition Executive to manage the complete recruitment lifecycle. The ideal candidate should have experience in sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing candidates, preferably within the EdTech, Education, BFSI, or Sales domains.

**Key Responsibilities (KRAs)**

* **End-to-End Recruitment:** Handle the complete recruitment cycle, from understanding hiring requirements to candidate onboarding.
* **Candidate Sourcing:** Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Apna, Indeed, employee referrals, and other recruitment platforms.
* **Screening & Shortlisting:** Screen CVs, conduct initial HR discussions, and evaluate candidates based on relevant experience, skills, and salary expectations.
* **Sales Hiring:** Manage bulk and lateral hiring for Admission Counselors, Senior Counselors, Team Leaders, B2B Counselors, CRM Executives, and other sales positions.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** Coordinate with hiring managers and department heads to understand job requirements and arrange interviews.
* **Interview Management:** Schedule and coordinate telephonic, virtual, and face-to-face interviews.
* **Offer Management:** Negotiate compensation, release offers, manage candidate follow-ups, and ensure successful offer-to-joining conversion.
* **Pipeline Management:** Maintain an active candidate database and ensure a consistent pipeline of qualified candidates.
* **Joining & Documentation:** Coordinate pre-joining formalities, document collection, background verification, and onboarding.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Maintain daily recruitment trackers, interview reports, offer status, joining reports, and hiring dashboards.

**Required Skills**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent sourcing and headhunting capabilities.
* Knowledge of recruitment portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, and Apna.
* Strong negotiation and candidate management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Good understanding of sales recruitment and hiring metrics.
* Target-oriented approach with strong follow-up skills.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:** 1–4 years in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
* **Preferred Industry:** EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, Insurance, or other target-driven industries.
* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.
* **Work Mode:** Work From Office

Regards  
Harshita

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Internet reimbursement

title: Senior Specialist Software Asset Management
description:
The Software Asset Management Specialist is an individual contributor role that is responsible for processing high volumes of software licensing orders and understanding how key licensing agreements work. You will be working closely with internal project and support teams, IT and external suppliers to ensure they are processed accurately whilst obtaining the best price and providing a high level of service to the customer. You will also drive opportunities to optimize license sharing, license usage and license optimization. You will define and maintain systems that help in the better management of our software, establishing a single source of truth on all Software assets in the organization. You will further mature this by defining key dashboards that allow actionable insights.

  

Responsibilities of this role include (but are not limited to):
  

* Process software Requests through defined lifecycle software asset management processes.

Ensure timely ordering and delivery of software licenses to meet service levels and provide a positive user-experience, especially for onboarding and to improve business productivity.
  

* Respond to escalations and licensing queries from stakeholders.
* Ensure compliant use of the license management tool within the operation. Maintain a single record so all WSP IT software assets are managed throughout their lifecycle, from procurement to deinstallation. All purchase related information must be captured and stored, including license entitlements, proof of purchase, license keys, activation information, and so on.
* Provide inputs to and maintain a software renewals calendar.
* Support software installation activities. Engage as required with software vendors, On Site Support teams and SCCM/Intune teams and supply the necessary information to ensure timely and accurate software delivery.
* Engage in license optimization initiatives. Collaborate with Engineering teams around optimization of engineering software.
* Support audit and compliance activity by providing reporting required to support audit/regulatory requirements.
* Provide necessary inputs into financial and budgetary processes.
* Through operational metrics analysis, highlight operational gaps and issues that require focus, ensure these are addressed as required in alignment with ITSM practices.
* Where processes and/or operating procedures may need adjusting to drive improvement, raise as required to ITSM Practices and provide feedback/inputs as necessary.
* Support transitional activities as operations are internalized and share knowledge as required.

Key Competencies
  
Mandatory Skills
  

* A clear understanding of the ITIL framework and an ability to apply ITIL principles within an

IT service management environment, ITIL qualification as standard.
  

* 5+ years of experience working in an ITIL aligned operational role (Software Asset Management or similar).
* Solid knowledge and experience of ServiceNow.

Desired Skills
  

* Enthusiasm and dedication to drive continual improvement and, or change.
* Excellent analytical and communication (both verbal and written) skills.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical skills and attention to detail
* Experience of working to (and exceeding) Service Level Agreements.
* Process orientated with a methodical and planned approach to achieving goals.
* Ability to quickly gain the confidence of the business and colleagues through building efficient working relationships and by exhibiting excellent communication and influencing skills.
* Ability to set own deadlines

* Act as an advocate for the IT organization both externally and internally.

title: US Healthcare Recruiter-Senior
description:
US Healthcare Recruiter

**Company:** Proxena Health Group LLC  
**Location:** Remote – India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time Contract / Independent Contractor  
**Compensation:** ₹55,000–₹62,000 per month, depending on experience  
**Initial Engagement:** 30-day paid evaluation contract, with potential for continued engagement based on performance and business requirements.

About Proxena Health Group

Proxena Health Group LLC is a US-based healthcare staffing and workforce solutions company supporting healthcare recruitment and staffing requirements across the United States.

We are seeking an experienced US Healthcare Recruiter based in India to support our growing recruitment operations. The successful candidate will take responsibility for identifying, engaging, screening and preparing qualified healthcare professionals for active US staffing opportunities.

This position requires practical experience in US healthcare agency recruitment, strong candidate-sourcing skills and the ability to work independently using established recruitment resources.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Candidate Sourcing**

* Source qualified US healthcare professionals through established recruitment platforms, job boards, professional networks and existing sourcing resources.
* Identify candidates whose clinical backgrounds align with active job requirements.
* Build and maintain an organised pipeline of potential candidates.
* Prioritise sourcing based on specialty, location, experience, schedule and assignment requirements.

**2. Candidate Outreach and Engagement**

* Contact prospective candidates through email, LinkedIn and telephone.
* Introduce relevant opportunities professionally.
* Establish candidate interest, availability and willingness to consider the assignment.
* Maintain consistent and appropriate follow-up communication.

**3. Resume Screening and Qualification Review**

* Review resumes against specific job descriptions.
* Assess specialty experience, clinical settings, required qualifications and employment history.
* Review applicable licences and certifications.
* Conduct preliminary professional licence checks through appropriate official sources where available.
* Identify missing information or qualification gaps before submission.

**4. Candidate Screening**

* Confirm current employment and candidate availability.
* Establish preferred locations, shifts, schedules and compensation expectations.
* Confirm relocation or travel willingness where relevant.
* Discuss assignment details and determine whether the candidate is genuinely interested.
* Obtain candidate authorisation before submitting their profile.

**5. Submission and Interview Coordination**

* Prepare complete candidate submission packages.
* Provide accurate screening notes and supporting information.
* Coordinate initial interviews and candidate availability.
* Follow up on interview outcomes and outstanding documentation.
* Maintain communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

**6. Recruitment Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate candidate records and outreach activity.
* Prevent duplicate submissions.
* Provide regular recruitment progress reports.
* Track candidate movement from sourcing through interview and placement stages.

Required Experience and Qualifications

* Minimum three years of hands-on US healthcare staffing recruitment experience.
* Experience recruiting Registered Nurses, Licensed Practical Nurses and allied healthcare professionals.
* Practical knowledge of travel nursing, contract staffing or US healthcare agency recruitment.
* Familiarity with clinical specialties, healthcare facility requirements and US professional licensing.
* Strong resume-screening and candidate-engagement abilities.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Good organisational, communication and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Ability to work with an agreed schedule that includes daily overlap with US business hours.

Experience recruiting allied-health professionals, surgical technologists, imaging technologists and other specialist clinical roles is particularly valuable.

Existing Tools and Equipment – Important

This is an independent contractor engagement. Applicants must already have:

* Their own reliable laptop and internet connection.
* A telephone and professional headset.
* Existing access to at least two legitimate candidate-sourcing channels or recruitment databases.
* Practical experience with candidate outreach, recruitment tracking and resume screening.

Please identify the sourcing platforms, databases and recruitment tools you currently have access to when applying.

**Proxena does not require applicants to purchase new software subscriptions for this position.** The role is intended for a recruiter who can independently source candidates using their existing resources and established recruitment methods.

Proxena will provide approved job requirements, candidate screening criteria, submission templates, outreach guidance and a secure process for managing candidate information.

All tools and candidate data must be used in accordance with applicable laws, platform terms and confidentiality requirements.

Working Arrangement

* Fully remote position based in India.
* Full-time working capacity, approximately 40 hours per week.
* Five working days per week, with an agreed daily overlap with US business hours.
* Monthly compensation within the stated range.
* Initial 30-day paid contract evaluation, with the possibility of continued engagement.

Performance Expectations

The initial target is approximately **10 qualified, interested and submission-ready candidates per week across assigned active requisitions**, following the initial onboarding period.

Candidate quality, accurate screening, candidate consent and suitability for the actual role take priority over submission volume.

Performance will be reviewed through weekly recruitment reports, submission quality, candidate engagement, interview progression and overall pipeline development.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume and include a brief explanation of:

* Your experience recruiting for US healthcare staffing agencies.
* The clinical specialties and healthcare roles you have recruited for.
* The sourcing platforms and tools you currently have legitimate access to.
* Your typical weekly candidate sourcing and submission capacity.
* Your availability to work with US business-hour overlap.

We are looking for a recruiter who can take ownership of candidate sourcing and delivery, work independently and contribute directly to Proxena's recruitment pipeline.

**Proxena Health Group LLC**  
Healthcare Staffing & Workforce Solutions

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹62,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
India's 11,099-kilometer coastline is home to 250 million people and supports key blue economy sectors including fisheries, tourism, agriculture, and transport. Despite its ecological richness, India's coastal ecosystems face mounting pressure from climate-induced hazards, coastal erosion, pollution, and land-use change. One-third of India's coastline is reported as vulnerable to erosion, threatening livelihoods, settlements, and biodiversity of global significance.  
  
The SHORE MPA has begun implementation in the states of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka under Phase 1 and will be expanded to other coastal states such as Goa, Maharashtra, Puducherry and West Bengal under subsequent phases. It aims to increase the resilience of targeted coastal communities and ecosystems, focusing on four components: (i) strengthening institutions for Integrated Coastal Zone Management (ICZM); (ii) shoreline management, coastal protection and conservation; (iii) improving livelihoods for natural resource-dependent communities; and (iv) enhancing marine pollution management and plastic circularity.  
  
Nature-based solutions (NBS) are central to Component 2, which supports mangrove, seagrass and coral reef conservation management and restoration, along with shelter belts, bio-shields, and hybrid coastal erosion management measures such as beach nourishment, sand dune stabilization, artificial reefs, and others. Where relevant, NBS investments should be coordinated with livelihood activities such as eco-tourism and mangrove-friendly value chains to ensure that conservation-livelihood tradeoffs are managed. The project also involves establishment of Centers of Excellence for coastal ecosystem management, long-term biodiversity monitoring, and eco-tourism.  
  
The Environment (ENV) Department in South Asia seeks to recruit a highly skilled and motivated ET Consultant (Nature-based Solutions Specialist) to provide technical, operational, and analytical support to the World Bank task team and the state-level implementing agencies in planning, implementing, and monitoring nature-based solutions for coastal resilience under the SHORE MPA. The ET Consultant will report to the ENV Practice Manager for the South Asia Region (SAR) and work under the supervision of the SHORE Task Team Leaders.  
  
The South Asia Region comprises six countries (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka) that range in size from India (with a population of over 1 billion) to Maldives (with 0.3 million people). The region has experienced a long period of robust economic growth, averaging 6% a year over the past 20 years. It was the second-fastest growing region in the world in the aftermath of the global crisis. This strong growth has translated into declining poverty and impressive improvements in human development. The percentage of people living below the poverty line fell in South Asia from 56% to 16% between 1981 and 2013. Still, the region remains home to a third of the world’s poorest, with 216 million people living below $1.9/day.  
  
The South Asia Region: https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/sar

The Environment Department (ENV), located within the World Bank’s Planet Practice Group has been established to deliver on the opportunities, benefits and outcomes offered by enhanced management of the environment and natural resources. ENV provides expertise, technical assistance and financing to help countries manage land, sea and freshwater natural resources in a sustainable way to help create jobs, improve livelihoods, enhance ecosystem services, decrease pollution and increase resilience to climate change. Over 360 ENV staff working across the globe help set developing countries on a clean, green growth trajectory for resilient economies and healthy communities.  
  
The SSAE1 unit comprises around 30 staff, with 95 percent based in Country Offices. The rest of the team is based in Washington DC. Our Sri Lanka country office is a joint World Bank/International Finance Cooperation office, comprising approximately 100 staff, including an ETC working on environment, providing a vibrant, collegial working environment.  
  
**Duties and accountabilities:**  
  
The ET Consultant will have the following tasks:  
  
**1)Technical Advisory and Operational Support**  
  

* Provide technical guidance to the task team and clients on the design, siting, and implementation of NBS interventions including mangrove, coastal sandy-soil & cliff forests, seagrass and coral reef conservation and restoration, bio-shields and shelter belts, and hybrid erosion management.
* Support preparation and quality review of sub-project-level technical designs for NBS activities, including for e.g. Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs), and Biodiversity Management Plans (BMPs).
* Advise on screening of NBS sub-project sites to avoid ecologically sensitive areas, no-go zones, and areas with high biodiversity value in line with State Coastal Zone Management Plans (CZMP) and Shoreline Management Plans (SMP).
* Contribute to Implementation Support Missions and progress report reviews from implementing agencies related to NBS design and implementation.

  
**2)Global Knowledge and Technical Expertise**  
  

* Support the implementation of nature-based solutions-related advisory services and knowledge products, including through technical inputs, guidance materials, and planning for the timely delivery of analytical products.
* Generate and curate knowledge, such as by identifying best practices and lessons learned on NBS for coastal protection, and promote dissemination at the national and global levels.
* Support the team in technical assessments/analyses related to NBS e.g. cost-benefit analysis frameworks for NBS interventions, assessment of ecosystem services and livelihoods benefits.
* Support the design and operationalization of long-term NBS/ecosystem monitoring programs in line with project results frameworks.

  
**3)Stakeholder Engagement and Capacity Building**  
  

* Contribute to the engagement and policy dialogue with government counterparts and other collaborators in the NBS space.
* Support capacity building and knowledge sharing activities for state officials, community groups, and technical staff on NBS principles, implementation, and adaptive management. This may include knowledge exchange between SHORE state teams, with national institutions (e.g., NCSCM, NIOT, NCCR, IIT-Madras, SDMRI), and with other countries that are implementing coastal NBS projects.
* Engage with local natural-resource dependent communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in the design of community-driven NBS interventions.

* Strong technical skills with remote sensing, coastal modeling tools, or GIS as applied to coastal ecosystem management.

description:
**E T Consultant - Coastal Infrastructure Engineer**

**Job #:**

req39137

  

**Organization:**

World Bank

  

**Sector:**

Environment

  

**Grade:**

EC2

  

**Term Duration:**

1 year 0 months

  

**Recruitment Type:**

Local Recruitment

  

**Location:**

New Delhi,India

  

**Required Language(s):**

English, Hindi

  

**Preferred Language(s):**

  

**Closing Date:**

11/26/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
India's 11,099 kilometer coastline is home to 250 million people and supports key blue economy sectors including fisheries, tourism, agriculture, and transport. Despite its ecological richness, India's coastal ecosystems face mounting pressure from climate-induced hazards, coastal erosion, pollution, and land-use change. One-third of India's coastline is reported as vulnerable to erosion, threatening livelihoods, settlements, and biodiversity of global significance.  
  
The Strengthening Coastal Resilience and the Economy (SHORE) program has begun implementation in the states of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka under Phase 1 and will be expanded to other coastal states such as Goa, Maharashtra, Puducherry and West Bengal under subsequent phases. It aims to increase the resilience of targeted coastal communities and ecosystems, focusing on four components: (i) strengthening institutions for Integrated Coastal Zone Management (ICZM); (ii) shoreline management, coastal protection and conservation; (iii) improving livelihoods for natural resource-dependent communities; and (iv) enhancing marine pollution management and plastic circularity.  
  
**The Position:**  
  
The Environment (ENV) Department in South Asia seeks to recruit a highly skilled recruit a highly skilled and motivated Extended Term (ET) Consultant (Coastal Engineering Specialist) who would work as part of various task teams involved in preparing and providing technical assistance to World Bank-financed projects/activities involving Coastal hydrodynamic processes, coastal protection/conservation measures and cruise terminal/harbour construction and modernization.  
  
This position will be based in New Delhi, India. The candidate is expected to work across several countries in the South Asia Region. The Coastal Engineer will report to the ENV Practice Manager for the South Asia Region (SAR) and work under the supervision of the SHORE Task Team Leaders.
  
  
The South Asia Region comprises six countries (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka) that range in size from India (with a population of over 1 billion) to Maldives (with 0.3 million people). The region has experienced a long period of robust economic growth, averaging 6% a year over the past 20 years. It was the second-fastest growing region in the world in the aftermath of the global crisis. This strong growth has translated into declining poverty and impressive improvements in human development. The percentage of people living below the poverty line fell in South Asia from 56% to 16% between 1981 and 2013. Still, the region remains home to a third of the world’s poorest, with 216 million people living below $1.9/day.  
  
The South Asia Region: https://www.worldbank.org/en/region/sar  
  
**The Unit**  
  
The Environment Department (ENV), located within the World Bank’s Planet Practice Group has been established to deliver on the opportunities, benefits and outcomes offered by enhanced management of the environment and natural resources. ENV provides expertise, technical assistance and financing to help countries manage land, sea and freshwater natural resources in a sustainable way to help create jobs, improve livelihoods, enhance ecosystem services, decrease pollution and increase resilience to climate change. Over 360 ENV staff working across the globe help set developing countries on a clean, green growth trajectory for resilient economies and healthy communities.  
  
The SSAE1 unit comprises around 30 staff, with 95 percent based in Country Offices. The rest of the team is based in Washington DC. Our Sri Lanka country office is a joint World Bank/International Finance Cooperation office, comprising approximately 100 staff, including an ETC working on environment, providing a vibrant, collegial working environment.  
Duties and accountabilities:  
  
**The ET Consultant will have the following tasks:**  
  

* Support the Bank team by providing engineering oversight and guidance on all infrastructure interventions, technical matters relating to planning, design, and implementation of the civil works activities related to protection, rehabilitation and integrated management of coastal areas. The grey infrastructure interventions may include, but not limited to, coastal protection structures such as submerged reefs, rubble mound breakwaters, concrete sea walls, groynes, pollution treatment/management plants, cruise terminal/ fishing harbors construction and modernization, ecotourism and other livelihoods related infrastructure.

  

* Assessing the proposed infrastructure investments by the client’s teams and providing guidance on: i) spatial targeting or grouping of the proposed investments; ii) assessing any environmental and social (E&S) risks to be considered and propose alternative technical design to mitigate those risks; iii) recommendations to enhance design to be consistent with overall conceptual framework of the project; iv) assessing technical designs to ensure sustainability and resilience of proposed infrastructure; v) ensuring that technical refinements agreed with the Bank’s team are duly included in the teams’ proposals and designs;

  

* Support the task teams in contributing to the preparation of TORs for studies and technical specifications; reviewing the detailed project reports (DPRs); provide Inputs to the draft reports which are to contribute to the project sub-component designs, and; provide guidance on hydrodynamic, climate change and sediment transport modeling intended for a better understanding of the functioning of the coastline and coastal risks,

  

* Provide assistance to the task team and the clients in advising on contract management such as quality control and ensure consultants’ compliance with contracts for engineering design, works supervision, investments operation and maintenance.

  

* Make site visits with other project officers to project intervention sites to review quality of civil works, material results and monthly progress reports, as well as make recommendations for the project on the overall achievement of the projects’ project and quality of works.

  

* Preparation and conduct of supervision missions from technical and financial partners as well as the monitoring of action plans resulting from said missions;

  

* Engage and collaborate with project stakeholders including beneficiaries for knowledge and skills transfer, relating to the prevention and management of coastal risks;

  

* Provide other inputs as requested and agreed with the Bank team.

**Selection Criteria**

* A master’s degree or its equivalent in coastal engineering discipline or civil/hydraulic engineering, specializing in maritime and/or coastal works, dredging, port works, jetties and large-scale mining of rock for breakwaters.

  

* Have at least 5 years of experience in the field of coastal and maritime engineering or coastal oceanography

  

* Have at least three (03) references in studies including the design of coastal protection works or maritime works;

  

* Have at least five (05) experiences in the control and monitoring of coastal or maritime protection works;

  

* Demonstrate knowledge in the specific associated fields such as: climate change, hydrology and coastal oceanography, marine environment, hydrodynamics, morphodynamics of coastal zones, digital

modeling, measurements, design and construction of port and maritime works, sedimentology, upkeep and maintenance maritime works;  
  

* Have a good knowledge of the following common and more specialized software for monitoring and modeling coastal or maritime dynamics will be an added advantage

  

* Have a good knowledge of the environmental and social safeguard measures of the World Bank

  

* Experience working on South Asia and familiarity with the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) Notification framework and ICZM principles in the Indian context is an advantage.

  

* Good team player who can work as a member of a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural team, motivate and lead group efforts and network effectively across boundaries.

  

* A drive for results while working with limited supervision and under tight timelines.

  
**Additional Considerations:**  
  
As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working on fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV)-related contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.
